name: High Fat Oxidation Barrier Rule
rationale: High lipid content coupled with extended shelf-life requires strict limitation of oxygen ingress (OTR < 2.0 mL/m²·day·atm) to prevent lipid autoxidation and rancidity.

name: Dry Food Crispness Retention (WVTR) Rule
rationale: Crisp dry products rapidly lose crispness when moisture uptake crosses the critical threshold. Maximum permissible WVTR must remain below critical water gain limits (WVTR < 2.0 g/m²·day).

name: Produce Respiration Equilibrium MAP Rule
rationale: Fresh produce consumes O2 and evolves CO2 continuously. The film permeability must equal the produce respiration rate at the storage temperature to maintain safe equilibrium O2 (3-5%) and avoid anaerobic off-flavors.

name: CO2 Accumulation Injury Prevention Rule
rationale: Carbon dioxide concentration inside modified atmosphere packs must not exceed the commodity tolerance threshold, requiring films with adequate CO2 permeability or micro-perforations.

name: Acidic Product Corrosion & Scalping Protection
rationale: Low pH acidic commodities require inert polymer contact layers (like high-grade PE or PP) to prevent chemical scalping and seal deterioration.

name: Extended Ambient Storage Barrier Maximization
rationale: Long-term ambient storage without refrigeration necessitates foil or high-barrier multi-layer laminates to withstand cumulative seasonal humidity and temperature fluctuations.
